response: Delivery is automatic. As soon as the payment is approved, the access e-mail goes out — usually within a couple of minutes. If it is not in your inbox, check spam and promotions first; if more than 15 minutes pass, email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}.
followup: Would you like the purchase link?

title: Delivery e-mail

response: The links are sent only to the e-mail used at checkout. Check spam, junk and promotions folders and search for the product name. Typed the address wrong or still nothing after 15 minutes? Email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} with your order details and we will resend the access.
followup: Do you want me to note this for support follow-up?

title: Download links
patterns: how do i download the files
response: Your e-mail contains the links to the download package plus access to the members area, where the files are organised and the setup tutorials live. If a link looks expired, email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} and we will issue a fresh one.
followup: Do you want help with extraction and copying to the USB?

title: Download problems
response: Try downloading in an incognito window or another browser, and use a stable connection. Most cloud drives let you pause and resume, so a dropped connection is not a problem. If the link itself is dead, email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} for a new one.

response: Yes — your access e-mail takes you to a members area with all download links, the organised package and the step-by-step setup tutorials. The updater inside the toolkit handles future versions from there.
